name: csharp.project_summary
description: Get a high-level overview of the active Revit project: project name/number, levels with elevations, total floor area (from Rooms), counts of sheets/schedules/views, and counts of walls/doors/windows/rooms/ducts/pipes. Use as a first-pass intake when the user asks 'tell me about this model', 'brief me on this project', 'what's in this Revit file', or any time a model overview is needed.
